import html from typing import List # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for author, title, body and tags. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author}

{body}
{tags_html}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str Author name. title : str Post title. body : str Main content of the post. post_tags : List[str] List of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string. """ # Escape all user-supplied text to prevent XSS or broken markup safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False).replace("\n", "
") # Build tags HTML: each tag inside a element safe_tags = [] for tag in post_tags: escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_tags.append(f'{escaped_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(safe_tags) # Render the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author=safe_author, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags_html=tags_html )
